scope: Authored new-API development contracts: locate directories across eight similar projects, then follow exact scoped IDs to original source. This fixture was written after the implementation; it is not an independent holdout, LLM answer benchmark, or cross-product ranking. Version 2 corrects eight invalid no-match expectations and adds eight lexically nonoverlapping negative cases; this is fixture correction, not an algorithm improvement.

baseline.reason: The preceding release has no search_directory/locate API. Existing manual browsing is not assigned a zero score.

contract.missing_project_scope: Unbound API calls explicitly search all projects; returned IDs retain each project. The evaluator supplies that exact returned project to every follow-up read. No project is guessed from a title or cwd.
contract.pagination: Count unique chapters; deduplicate before limiting; follow next_offset until complete
contract.source_validation: Independently reconstruct original paired message turns. Require every follow-up page character and coordinate to match frozen originals and the selected project/chapter/section.
contract.metadata: Stored titles and summaries may contain source-derived text; they are navigation metadata, not authoritative retrieved evidence.
contract.timing: No latency values, repeated speed trials or relative performance claims.

failure_policy: Keep raw JSONL after each actual call, preserve every failed case, use a new output directory for every attempt; never overwrite a failed report.
